summary: Build a professional business website for Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center including business details, services, and contact information.
architectural_notes: Support using a user-supplied shop board photo as the primary logo and/or hero/banner image instead of (or in addition to) generated assets.
known_issues: Deployed/live website URL is not opening; user requests redeploy and a working final live URL.

existing_features.title: Create a professional, single-page business website in English for “Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center” that clearly presents the business name and a prominent headline suitable for a document services center.
Add an “About” section that displays the owner name exactly as: “Owner: Sheikh Mohammad Salman”.
Add a “Services” section listing the offered services exactly and clearly: Online Forms for PAN, Aadhaar, and Voter ID.

Add a “Visit Us” / “Location” section that displays the full office address exactly as provided, and include a safe outbound link to open the address in a map website (link only; no embedded map/GPS features required).
Add a “Contact” section that displays the phone number and email exactly as provided, with clickable actions (tel: and mailto:).
Create a consistent, professional visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, and section layout) appropriate for a local document services business; avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette.
Add a simple top navigation (or sticky header) with anchor links that smoothly scroll to: Home, Services, About, Location, Contact; include a footer repeating the business name and contact details.
Render the generated static images (logo and hero/banner) from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them on the site (logo in header/footer; banner/hero visual in the hero section).

Add the user-provided shop board photo to the frontend as static image assets and prepare two optimized variants: one wide banner image and one square logo crop, both suitable for high-quality display on the site.

Update the website UI to use the shop board photo variants as the primary branding visuals: use the square crop in the header and footer in place of the current generated logo, and use the wide crop as the hero background/banner in place of the current generated hero image.

Add a small "Live URL" display in the site footer that shows the current site origin (e.g., https://... ) with a copy-to-clipboard button so the user can retrieve the correct live URL directly from the deployed site.
Make static asset URLs (shop-board logo and banner) robust to different deployment base paths by avoiding hard-coded absolute paths that can break when the app is not served from domain root.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a professional business website for Sheikh Mohammad Saad Document Center (owner Sheikh Mohammad Salman) showcasing services (online forms for PAN, Aadhaar, Voter ID) and displaying office address and contact details (phone/email).
Use the user-provided shop board photo as the primary branding visual (main logo and/or hero/banner image) on the website.
Redeploy the website and provide the final working live URL as part of the deployment output/instructions.
